source.credential_check: OPENCODE_API_KEY presence only; value not read or retained

invocation_plan.session: resume session-a through untracked runtime identifier

stop_conditions: stop immediately on authentication or provider failure
do not exceed two OpenCode invocations, two successful model steps, 120 seconds, or zero dollars
redaction_policy: pass authentication as an inherited environment variable without reading or retaining its value
retain raw runtime output only below the ignored artifact destination
retain source-event excerpts only after removing raw session, message, part, cache namespace, and prompt content
retain submitted prompts and runtime session identifiers only as SHA-256 in normalized evidence
claim_limits: model-step sequencing is runtime-visible; native provider request identity and count remain unavailable
cache fill is reported only when a runtime cache-write field is available and positive; otherwise the fill field is explicitly unavailable
provider-visible prefix, breakpoint, key, isolation, and provider-internal miss reasons remain unavailable
